ms.promise:
The Marlowe learning pathway for beginners over the course of 8 weeks:
・Week 1: Introduction to Marlowe and Smart Contracts
・Week 2: The Marlowe data types
・Week 3: Marlowe embedded in Haskell and javascript
・Week 4: Potential problems with contracts
・Week 5: Static analysis 
・Week 6: Marlowe escrow step-by-step
・Week 7: Implementing Marlowe in Plutus
・Week 8: Demo Projects and Advanced Marlowe Concepts

Course Documentation Package:
・Context: Comprehensive documentation summarizing each week's content, including key concepts, examples, and exercises. This can serve as a reference for participants.
・Number: 1 complete documentation package covering all 8 weeks.

Weekly Progress Reports:
・Context: These reports will provide a summary of each week's activities, including topics covered, participant engagement levels, and any notable feedback or observations.
・Number: 8 weekly progress reports, one for each week of the program.
ms.criteria:
・Weekly Tutorial Videos: 8 videos, each approximately one hour in duration, with pre-prepared content.
・Participant Engagement: A minimum of 50 views per video, accompanied by interactions.
・Weekly Progress Reports: Eight reports corresponding to eight weeks, including lecture content, presenter details, participant numbers, and interaction statistics.
